title: Ability to show some desktop notifications on the lock screen
line: The lock screen can now show how many notifications each app sent while the screen was locked.
explanation: The desktop lock screen had no way to show anything about notifications that arrived while the screen was locked, so the user had to unlock to find out whether anything happened. Showing them needs to be optional and privacy-aware. The change adds an opt-in "Notifications: Show how many arrived while locked" option to the lock screen appearance settings (off by default). When it is on, the lock screen lists under the unlocking prompt, per application, how many notifications arrived (e.g. "3 notifications from Thunderbird"), with no summaries or bodies, using libnotificationmanager's existing WatchedNotificationsModel through a singleton shared by all screens.

commits.message:
lockscreen: optionally show how many notifications arrived while locked

The lock screen gave no hint of anything that happened while away. A new
opt-in appearance setting lists under the unlocking prompt how many
notifications each application sent, without showing their content.

BUG: 343688

diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockedNotifications.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockedNotifications.qml
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..9fc7eac591
--- /dev/null
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockedNotifications.qml
@@ -0,0 +1,53 @@
+/*
+    SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Niccolò Venerandi <niccolo@venerandi.com>
+
+    SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
+*/
+
+pragma Singleton
+
+import QtQuick
+
+import org.kde.notificationmanager as NotificationManager
+
+// Shared by the lock screens of all outputs, so that only one notification watcher is registered
+QtObject {
+    id: lockedNotifications
+
+    // [{ name, iconName, count }] for each application that sent notifications while locked
+    property var applications: []
+
+    function update() {
+        const result = [];
+        for (let i = 0; i < instantiator.count; ++i) {
+            const notification = instantiator.objectAt(i);
+            if (!notification || notification.isTransient) {
+                continue;
+            }
+            const application = result.find(application => application.name === notification.applicationName);
+            if (application) {
+                ++application.count;
+            } else {
+                result.push({
+                    name: notification.applicationName,
+                    iconName: notification.applicationIconName,
+                    count: 1,
+                });
+            }
+        }
+        applications = result;
+    }
+
+    property Instantiator instantiator: Instantiator {
+        model: NotificationManager.WatchedNotificationsModel {}
+
+        delegate: QtObject {
+            readonly property string applicationName: model.applicationName
+            readonly property string applicationIconName: model.applicationIconName
+            readonly property bool isTransient: model.transient
+        }
+
+        onObjectAdded: lockedNotifications.update()
+        onObjectRemoved: lockedNotifications.update()
+    }
+}
diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/NotificationsSummary.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/NotificationsSummary.qml
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..721298e869
--- /dev/null
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/NotificationsSummary.qml
@@ -0,0 +1,43 @@
+/*
+    SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Niccolò Venerandi <niccolo@venerandi.com>
+
+    SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
+*/
+
+import QtQuick
+import QtQuick.Layouts
+
+import org.kde.plasma.components as PlasmaComponents3
+import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
+
+ColumnLayout {
+    visible: LockedNotifications.applications.length > 0
+    spacing: Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
+
+    Repeater {
+        model: LockedNotifications.applications
+
+        RowLayout {
+            required property var modelData
+
+            Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignHCenter
+            Layout.maximumWidth: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 16
+            spacing: Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
+
+            Kirigami.Icon {
+                Layout.preferredWidth: Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.smallMedium
+                Layout.preferredHeight: Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.smallMedium
+                source: modelData.iconName || "preferences-desktop-notification-bell"
+            }
+
+            PlasmaComponents3.Label {
+                Layout.fillWidth: true
+                elide: Text.ElideRight
+                textFormat: Text.PlainText
+                text: modelData.name
+                    ? i18ndp("plasma_shell_org.kde.plasma.desktop", "%1 notification from %2", "%1 notifications from %2", modelData.count, modelData.name)
+                    : i18ndp("plasma_shell_org.kde.plasma.desktop", "%1 notification", "%1 notifications", modelData.count)
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

media.caption: Master: 4 notifications sent while locked (3 Thunderbird, 1 Discord); the lock screen shows nothing.
With the option on: the same notifications are summarised per app under the unlocking prompt, without their content.
Master: Screen Locking > Configure Appearance has no notifications option.
New opt-in checkbox "Notifications: Show how many arrived while locked" (off by default).
